algorithm: IoU intersection/union produces the matching score. Tracks expire after max_age ticks; greedy assignments prevent two detections sharing one track in a frame. Queue admission separates produced, processed and dropped counters.
architecture: Synthetic frame iterator → bounded asyncio queue → metadata detector → camera-local tracker → line-region events → JSON dashboard.
data_model: Frame = stream, tick, boxes. Box = x1,y1,x2,y2. Track records include stable local IDs and last-seen ticks. Metrics include exact conservation.
description: A bounded asynchronous ingestion and tracking reference with explicit overload accounting and event extraction.
design: A bounded queue exposes the throughput/latency tradeoff. Missing detections are not dropped frames. Event alerts are region observations, not unique crossing counts.
family_notes: Track one synthetic object per camera.
Track two moving objects on separate lanes.
Use drop-newest admission and reconcile dropped frames.
Frames with no detections must remain accounted for.
Exercise queue backpressure with a dense producer burst.
Preserve short-lived tracks through missing detections.
limitations: Default frames contain synthetic boxes, not images, audio or pretrained detections. There is no YOLO, INT8 inference, Kafka, WebSocket transport or GPU validation. Steady producers yield between frames; burst producers push until backpressure blocks them. IoU matching is greedy and cannot reliably resolve severe occlusion. A finite queue must backpressure or drop under overload.
operations: Choose backpressure when the source can wait; use a documented discard policy for a live source. Integrate capture and inference behind the detector interface and measure queue delay separately.
scope: Bounded frame queue, backpressure/drop policies, IoU association, per-camera tracking, synthetic line alerts and an optional OpenCV frame-count adapter.
security: Treat this as educational code; review it before handling trusted data.
title: Real-Time Multimodal Video Analytics Pipeline
